fr.elements: Main Residence; Solar Panel System; Vehicle Parking Area; Landscaped Area; Walkway
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Vegetation Near Structure
fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from both directions on the road.
• Keep the single driveway clear of parked vehicles to allow emergency vehicles to reach the structure.
• Identify and designate a secondary staging area on the property where emergency vehicles can turn around without blocking the driveway.
• Trim vegetation that contacts or overhangs the roofline near the solar panel system.
• Keep a clear walking path along at least one side of the structure for responders moving between the front and rear of the building.
• Mark the location of the main electrical disconnect and solar system shutoff with visible labels accessible from outside the structure.
• Keep the walkway to the main entrance clear of plants, furniture, or objects that could slow responders carrying equipment.

wildfire.conditions: Tree Cluster; Scattered Shrubs; Open Terrain; Adequate Vegetation Separation; None Visible
wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin the tree cluster to reduce the amount of connected vegetation that could carry fire toward the structure.
• Remove any dead branches or dry material within the tree cluster.
• Trim shrubs that are closest to the structure or any outbuildings.
• Keep open ground between scattered shrubs and the base of any trees.
• Maintain the existing open terrain by keeping it clear of new shrub or brush growth.
